messages:
Maya (Marketing): Quick check — final logistics for Thursday's virtual launch workshop. Need greenroom host, Zoom config, recording owner, and post-event follow-up cadence. Can everyone confirm by EOD? :raised_hands:

Jon (Events): Greenroom reserved 30m before start. I'll be the greenroom host. Zoom link is in the invite. No RTMP fallback planned unless we see streaming demand — thoughts?

Priya (Ops): Registration page updated: timezone auto-detect + cap 500. HubSpot form mapped to list `webinar_signups_launch_apr`. Added hidden field `utm_experiment=benchmark_v1`. Confirming GDPR consent checkbox is on.

Sam (Growth): HubSpot->Zapier->Segment mapping is done. Mapping: `hs_email`->`email`, `company`->`org_name`, `interest_topic`->`lead_tag`. Will create SFDC Campaign 'Launch-Apr-2026' and push leads there.

Ethan (Content): Who owns the recording and edit timeline? I'll produce the highlight clip + 1-pager. Need raw file access by Fri 10am for edits.

Maya (Marketing): Hosts: host=@Jon, co-hosts=@Maya,@Priya,@Ethan. Greenroom run order: 1) AV check 2) slides pass 3) backup demo 4) timing. Use this Zoom settings snippet in greenroom:
```
Zoom settings:
- Cloud recording: ON (host)
- Auto-record to cloud: enabled
- Waiting room: OFF
- Mute participants on entry: ON
- Allow participants to unmute: OFF until Q&A
- Co-hosts: jon@example.com, maya@example.com, priya@example.com
```

Priya (Ops): Set cloud recording retention 30 days and download permission host-only. I'll add download/transfer instructions to the calendar note. Also will pin the registration list export schedule (T+0.5h).

Sam (Growth): Draft post-event email cadence: immediate (within 1h): replay + 1-pager + CTA to book demo; day 3: benchmark blog + short clip; day 10: nurture + invite to office hours. I'll wire these into HubSpot workflows `replay_send`, `benchmarks_drip`, `nurture_10d`.

Ethan (Content): ETA for assets: Wed 5pm for 1-pager and edit plan. Will request raw after host downloads. Tag any clip requests with `event:launch-apr` in assets channel.

Jon (Events): Live captions enabled and transcript export ON. I'll pin the slide PDF in Zoom chat when we start. Greenroom dry-run 30m before show.

ZoomBot: Recording scheduled to auto-start when host joins. Cloud storage enabled.

Maya (Marketing): Small owner checklist: Priya — confirm HubSpot mapping & retention; Jon — greenroom host & slides; Ethan — clip ownership; Sam — workflow drafts. React with :thumbsup: when done.

Priya (Ops): Confirmed mapping and retention. :white_check_mark:

Jon (Events): Greenroom/slide pin set. I'll run the run-through Thurs T-30. :rocket:

Ethan (Content): Granting download access to `ethan@example.com` and `maya@example.com` once recording is available. :clapper:

Sam (Growth): Workflows in draft; will hand to Maya for final copy. :gear:

Maya (Marketing): Thanks team. Reminder: A/B test replay subject lines — emphasize 'predictable latency' vs 'cost per token savings'. Drop any last-minute asks here.

Jon (Events): Noted — see you in greenroom.

ZoomBot: Host Jon joined the meeting. Recording started at 2024-04-04 16:00:12 UTC.
